A.name: Kadmiel
A.line: stood on the Levites platform (NEH 9:4) and exhorted Israel to bless the Lord (NEH 9:5)
A.notes: named on the sealed document of NEH 10:1-27 (NEH 10:9)
family: descendant-of levi (Levi, third-born son of Jacob (GEN 29:34), son of Leah)

B.name: Kadmiel
B.line: his sons (descendants) returned to Judah after captivity (EZR 2:40)
family: descendant-of hodaviah-5 (Hodaviah, his sons (descendants) returned to Judah after captivity (EZ)

why: The Hebrew lists קַדְמִיאֵל among the Levites sealing the covenant, matching A’s participation in Nehemiah 9 and stated role in Nehemiah 10:9. B is identified as an ancestor of returning descendants, a relationship not indicated here.
